paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption: Pass@8 accuracy (on the merge sets of AIME 2024 and AMC) under different generation temperatures.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the performance with respect to temperature, focusing on accuracy measured by Pass@8. The x-axis is labeled "Temperature," with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, and tick labels are regularly spaced at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)" and also has a linear scale, ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. There are three lines in the plot. The "On-policy RL" line is yellow with a triangle marker and a solid line style, starting at approximately 63.0 at 0.1 and ending around 73.0 at 1.0, showing a distinct peak at 0.8 with a value of 75.0. The "LUFFY" line is red with a star marker and a solid line style, starting at approximately 76.0 at 0.1 and ending at about 81.0 at 1.0, maintaining a relatively steady trend with minor fluctuations and a peak at around 81.0 at 0.8 and 1. The "SFT" line is teal with an inverted triangle marker and a solid line style, starting at approximately 73.0 at 0.1 and ending around 74.0 at 1.0, displaying fluctuations with a notable dip to approximately 70 at 0.5 before slightly recovering. A legend is placed at the bottom center of the plot describing the line pattern with corresponding performance metrics.
